package rulefixtures

import (
	"os"
)

// scenario for bufio_writer_missing_in_bulk_export: File or socket writes inside loops without visible bufio buffering.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

func scenario344Positive(f *os.File, items []string) error {
	for _, item := range items {
		if _, err := f.WriteString(item); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := f.WriteString("\n"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
